name: Amador Medical, LLC
old_description: Designed to meet your budget and guarantee your satisfaction.
about:
Amador Medical, LLC operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, where it was founded in 2011 as a family-owned business. What began as a small local operation has grown into the largest incontinence supplier in the state, serving the broader Southern Nevada and Idaho region.

The company distributes a comprehensive inventory of home medical equipment and supplies. Its product lines include incontinence supplies, mobility devices, power mobility devices, and bathroom safety durable medical equipment. Most items are kept in stock for immediate delivery, with same-day service available in the Las Vegas area.

Customers range from individuals managing temporary recovery at home to those with ongoing conditions, as well as caregivers and community partners. The company serves the senior-care market, home-health agencies, and anyone needing reliable access to mobility and incontinence products across Southern Nevada and into Idaho.

Amador Medical states that compassion is its company motto. The business was built on the belief that carrying high-quality products at affordable prices earns the trust of the communities it serves, and it emphasizes personalized attention throughout the selection and delivery process.
